This '''sword''' was the personal [[Sword/Legends|sword]] of the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who created the sword using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and wielded it during his self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Following Sadow's [[Death/Legends|death]] c.[[4400 BBY]], the sword was lost, likely on Yavin 4, and remained lost by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]], when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Talos Drellik]] used the sword as an example of one of many artefacts associated with Sadow that had been lost.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Alchemy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This sword cannot be [[Naga Sadow's poison blade]], as that weapon is referenced alongside this one. It may be [[Heta Kol's Sith sword|the sword that Heta Kol found on]] [[Khar Shian]], however this is unconfirmed.
